title: Operational Status
subtitle: Health of Monitor components and SLOs
schemaSectionHint: Compares each LibreChat collection this project reads against the shape its own queries assume. Informational only — a drift never blocks anything, but a figure derived from that collection may need a second look.
featureSectionHint: Every one of these is off by default and only turns on when a deployment specifically configures it — the core dashboards (adoption, usage, security, audit) don't need any of them.
